lines.text: On Mount Sinai the LORD tells Moses that the land must rest completely in the seventh year.
After counting seven Sabbaths of years, the horn sounds on the Day of Atonement, and liberty is proclaimed in the fiftieth year.
God promises to bless the land in the sixth year so it yields a crop sufficient for five years.
If a man becomes impoverished and sells some property, the high priest may redeem what his brother has sold.
The Israelites must not be sold as slaves because they are God's servants, whom He brought out of Egypt.
